address: Cheval Blanc, Le Jardin Alpin, Courchevel 1850, Courchevel, 73120, France
bio: Under the leadership of Yannick Alléno, the chic Alpine brasserie of the upscale Cheval Blanc hotel has brilliantly reinvented high-altitude dining, serving up a contemporary and uninhibited fine dining offering. Your taste buds won't know what hit them! A sublime list of top-of-the-range wines....
